RaynorGiveEmSomePepperExterminator.name: Exterminator
RaynorGiveEmSomePepperExterminator.description: Basic Attacks deal 50% more damage to Minions, Mercenaries, and Monsters. This is increased to 125% while Inspire is active. Passive: Inspire does not expire on friendly Minions and Mercenaries.

RaynorVeteranMarksman.name: Veteran Marksman
RaynorVeteranMarksman.description: Quest: Every time the primary target of Give 'Em Some Pepper is a Hero, permanently increase its damage bonus by 0.75%. Gambit: Gain 60% bonus Give 'Em Some Pepper damage. Every death reduces this bonus by 15%.

RaynorAceInTheHole.name: Ace In The Hole
RaynorAceInTheHole.description: Deal 12% more damage to Stunned or Slowed Heroes. Enemy Heroes hit by Give 'Em Some Pepper are Slowed by 10% for 2.5 seconds.

RaynorMasteryFightorFlightAdrenalineRush.name: Fight or Flight
RaynorMasteryFightorFlightAdrenalineRush.description: Reduce Adrenaline Rush's cooldown by 10 seconds. Casting Adrenaline Rush grants 25 Armor for 3 seconds.

RaynorBasicAttackSustainingRounds.name: Sustaining Rounds
RaynorBasicAttackSustainingRounds.description: Give 'Em Some Pepper heals Raynor for 3% of his maximum Health, increased to 6% if the primary target is a Hero.

RaynorBehemothArmor.name: Behemoth Armor
RaynorBehemothArmor.description: Gain 200 bonus maximum Health. Quest: Every time Give 'Em Some Pepper's primary target is a Hero, gain an additional 8 maximum Health.

RaynorPenetratingRoundHeavySlugs.name: Heavy Slugs
RaynorPenetratingRoundHeavySlugs.description: Increase Penetrating Round's Slow by 15% and its duration by 2 seconds.

RaynorInspireFuelTheRush.name: Fuel The Rush
RaynorInspireFuelTheRush.description: Reduce the Mana cost of Adrenaline Rush from 75 to 45. While Inspire is active, increase Adrenaline Rush's cooldown reduction from Basic Attacks by 300%.

RaynorGiveEmSomePepperUnstableCompound.name: Unstable Compound
RaynorGiveEmSomePepperUnstableCompound.description: Increase the area of Give 'Em Some Pepper by 15%. Each enemy Hero hit by Give 'Em Some Pepper grants Raynor 10 Mana and reduces the cooldown of Penetrating Round by 1.5 seconds.

RaynorHeroicAbilityHyperion.name: Hyperion
RaynorHeroicAbilityHyperion.description: Order the Hyperion to make a strafing run for 12 seconds, hitting up to 4 enemies for 66 (+4% per level) damage every second. Every 4 seconds, it can fire its Yamato Cannon at a Structure, dealing 794 (+4% per level) damage.

RaynorHeroicAbilityRaynorsRaiders.name: Raynor's Raider
RaynorHeroicAbilityRaynorsRaiders.description: Summon a Banshee that assists Raynor. The Banshee deals 84 (+4% per level) damage per second and regenerates 75 (+4% per level) Health per second if it hasn't taken damage in the last 4 seconds. Can reactivate to retarget or move the Banshee. The Banshee respawns automatically af

RaynorPenetratingRoundLine'EmUp.name: Line 'Em Up
RaynorPenetratingRoundLine'EmUp.description: Reduce the cooldown of Penetrating Round by 3 seconds. Penetrating Round hitting two or more enemy Heroes reduces its cooldown by an additional 3 seconds.

RaynorInspireGiddyUp.name: Giddy-Up
RaynorInspireGiddyUp.description: Gain 10% Movement Speed while mounted and unmounted. Inspire grants 10% more Movement Speed.

RaynorMasteryGiveMeMoreAdrenalineRush.name: Give Me More!
RaynorMasteryGiveMeMoreAdrenalineRush.description: Increase Adrenaline Rush healing by 50%. While Inspire is active, gain 1 Basic Attack range.

RaynorPenetratingRoundPaintThemRed.name: Paint Them Red
RaynorPenetratingRoundPaintThemRed.description: Increase the damage of Penetrating Round by 50% and heal for 90% of the damage Penetrating Round deals to Heroes.

RaynorInspireRallyingCry.name: Rallying Cry
RaynorInspireRallyingCry.description: Increase the Attack Speed bonus of Inspire by 20%. Passive: After every 12 Basic Attacks, cast Inspire for free.

RaynorBountyHunter.name: Bounty Hunter
RaynorBountyHunter.description: If Give 'Em Some Pepper's target is a Hero, it deals an additional 3% of their maximum Health as damage and grants Raynor 10 Armor for 3 seconds. Activate Give 'Em Some Pepper to apply it to Raynor's next Basic Attack.

RaynorHyperionCavalrysArrived.name: Cavalry's Arrived
RaynorHyperionCavalrysArrived.description: Give 'Em Some Pepper lowers the cooldown of Hyperion by 5 seconds if the primary target is a Hero. These Heroes are targeted by the Hyperion for 100% increased damage for 6 seconds.

RaynorDuskWing.name: Dusk Wing
RaynorDuskWing.description: Increase the Health and leash range of Raynor's Raider by 100%. Its Basic Attack lowers enemy Hero Armor by 3 for 1 second, stacking up to 30.

RaynorAdrenalineRushRaidersRoll.name: Raiders Roll
RaynorAdrenalineRushRaidersRoll.description: Adrenaline Rush grants Unstoppable and continues healing for an additional 2 seconds. The additional duration ends upon reaching 70% Health.

RaynorGive'EmSomePepperSergeantPepper.name: Sergeant Pepper
RaynorGive'EmSomePepperSergeantPepper.description: Give 'Em Some Pepper now activates every 3 Basic Attacks.

RaynorHyperionExecuteOrders.name: Execute Orders
RaynorHyperionExecuteOrders.description: Reduce Raynor's death timer by 35 seconds. Upon death, the Hyperion is cast towards the closest enemy Hero.
